title: Cloud accounts
hint: For GCP the service-account key belongs to a project, not the account — permissions are granted per project.
syncQueued: Sync queued. It runs in the background and data arrives gradually — success here only means the job was accepted.
syncPreparing: Syncing: fetching the instance list from the provider…
syncDoneStale: Sync finished: {{synced}} hosts in use, {{stale}} no longer exist in the cloud
addDesc: The account is just a grouping; to collect anything, add a project under it and configure a key.
addProjectDesc: The key is encrypted before storage and the API never reads it back.
deleteImpact: This account has {{count}} project(s). Deleting it stops their collection immediately. Already collected hosts are kept but will gradually be marked destroyed.

field.name: Account name
field.nameHint: A human-facing name such as “Production GCP”. Can be changed later.
field.datasetHint: The BigQuery billing export table. Without it costs can only be estimated from machine types.
field.projectIdHint: The GCP Project ID (not the display name). A wrong value makes collection fail with 404 forever.
field.saKeyHint: Paste the whole JSON. compute.viewer is the minimum required role; leave blank to add the key later.
field.saKeyKeepHint: Leave empty to keep the existing credential. Only a non-empty value replaces it — the API never reads stored credentials back.

empty.title: No cloud account connected
empty.reason: Until one is connected, the Hosts, Networks and Load balancer pages stay empty.

delProject.title: Delete this cloud project
delProject.body: After deleting "{{project}}", collection stops for every resource in it. Already-collected data is kept but never updates again — those hosts still look normal in the list, with "last synced" frozen at this moment.

needCred: This project has no SA key yet, so a sync would return nothing
editProjectDesc: Change the display name or rotate credentials.
totalHosts: {{projects}} projects, {{hosts}} hosts in use in total
